title: Chinstrap Penguin Population In The Last 50 Years
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.translation: 有史以來錄得的最高氣溫。

blocks.text: “The latest study was published just days after an all-time Antarctic high of 18.3°C (64.94°F) was recorded on 6 February.”
最新研究發表前幾天，南極在 2 月 6 日剛錄得 18.3°C 的歷史最高氣溫。
“Scientists recorded the temperature at Argentina’s Esperanza research station, according to the country’s meteorological agency.”
根據阿根廷氣象機構，科學家在阿根廷 Esperanza 研究站記錄到這個溫度。
題目最有定位力的是 “highest temperatures ever recorded”。原文對應 “an all-time Antarctic high” 和 “previous high”。
“The previous high of 17.5°C (63.5°F) was recorded in March 2015.”
之前的最高紀錄是 17.5°C，於 2015 年 3 月錄得。
The highest temperatures ever recorded= an all-time Antarctic high= the previous high所以答案是 D。

questions.prompt: A comparison between current and past records of penguin populations
questions.translation: 現時和過去企鵝數量紀錄的比較。

blocks.text: “Every colony on Elephant Island, a crucial penguin habitat northeast of the Antarctic Peninsula, experienced a population decline…”
Elephant Island 上每一個 colony 都出現了數量下降。
“…the most significant decline was recorded at a colony known as Chinstrap Camp, where the population fell by 77%.”
最大跌幅出現在 Chinstrap Camp，該處數量下降 77%。
題目中的 “current and past records” 對應原文的 “last surveyed in 1971” 和 “recent count”。
“Elephant Island was last surveyed in 1971, and there were 122,550 pairs of penguins across all colonies. However, the recent count revealed just 52,786 pairs—a drop of almost 60%.”
Elephant Island 上一次調查是在 1971 年，當時所有 colonies 共有 122,550 對企鵝。然而，最近一次點算只錄得 52,786 對，下降接近 60%。
past records = last surveyed in 1971 / 122,550 pairs current records = recent count / 52,786 pairs comparison = a drop of almost 60%所以答案是 C。

questions.prompt: Places that people are prohibited from entering
questions.translation: 人類被禁止進入的地方。

blocks.text: “The Greenpeace ship Esperanza has been documenting the threat to the oceans worldwide and transporting scientists on overseas expeditions.”
Greenpeace ship Esperanza 一直記錄全球海洋面對的威脅，並運送科學家參與海外考察。
這些地方將會禁止人類進入。
題目中的 “prohibited from entering” 不一定原字出現。應掃描 avoid / ban / off-limits / no entry。
原文的 “off-limits to humans” 是直接對應。
“Greenpeace has been campaigning for the establishment of three Antarctic sanctuaries to protect many of the colonies surveyed. These would be off-limits to humans.”
Greenpeace 一直爭取建立三個 Antarctic sanctuaries，以保護許多已調查的 colonies。這些sanctuary 將會禁止人類進入。
places = Antarctic sanctuaries people are prohibited from entering = off-limits to humans所以答案是 G。
“The chinstrap penguin has a cap of black plumage, a white face, and a continuous band of black feathers…”
chinstrap penguin 有黑色羽冠、白色臉部，以及一條連續的黑色羽毛帶。
“The northern part of the Antarctic Peninsula, several Antarctic and subantarctic islands, and the uninhabited Balleny Islands between Antarctica and New Zealand are habitats of the species.”
Antarctic Peninsula 北部、幾個 Antarctic 和 subantarctic islands，以及 Antarctica 與 New Zealand 之間無人居住的 Balleny Islands，都是這個物種的棲息地。
題目中的 “places where … live” 對應原文 “habitats of the species”。
“The northern part of the Antarctic Peninsula… are habitats of the species.”
places where chinstrap penguins live= habitats of the species所以答案是 A。

questions.prompt: Measures intended to protect marine species
questions.translation: 旨在保護海洋物種的措施。

blocks.text: “Louisa Casson, Greenpeace Oceans Campaigner, said… the climate emergency is decimating their numbers…”
Greenpeace Oceans Campaigner Louisa Casson 表示，氣候緊急狀態正在大幅削減企鵝數量。
“Governments must respond to the science and agree on a strong Global Ocean Treaty… that can create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect marine life…”
各國政府必須回應科學證據，並同意一項強而有力的 Global Ocean Treaty，以建立 ocean sanctuaries 網絡來保護 marine life。
“protect marine species” 可對應 “protect marine life”。“measures” 可對應 Global Ocean Treaty和 network of ocean sanctuaries。
“Governments must respond to the science and agree on a strong Global Ocean Treaty… that can create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect marine life…”
measures = Global Ocean Treaty / network of ocean sanctuaries marine species = marine life intended to protect = to protect所以答案是 H。

questions.prompt: Factors contributing to a decline in the penguins’ food supply
questions.translation: 導致企鵝食物供應下降的因素。

blocks.text: “The reduced sea ice and warmer oceans caused by climate change have reduced the amount of krill…”
由氣候變化引起的海冰減少和海洋變暖，已經令 krill 的數量下降。
“…all the evidence we have points to climate change as being responsible for the changes we are seeing.”
我們擁有的所有證據都指向 climate change，顯示它要為目前的變化負上責任。
題目中的 “food supply” 對應原文 “krill, the main component of the penguins’ diet”。
“The reduced sea ice and warmer oceans caused by climate change have reduced the amount of krill, the main component of the penguins’ diet.”
由氣候變化造成的海冰減少和海洋變暖，減少了 krill 的數量；krill 是企鵝飲食的主要成分。
food supply = krill factors contributing to decline = reduced sea ice and warmer oceans caused by climate change decline = reduced the amount所以答案是 E。

questions.prompt: A description of a particular species

blocks.text: “The chinstrap penguin has a cap of black plumage, a white face, and a continuous band of black feathers…”
chinstrap penguin 有黑色羽冠、白色臉部，以及一條連續的黑色羽毛帶。
這些地方是該物種的棲息地。
“description” 通常找外貌、特徵、身體部位、顏色。A 段有 “black plumage”、“white face”、“band of black feathers”。
“The chinstrap penguin has a cap of black plumage, a white face, and a continuous band of black feathers extending from one side of the head to the other, the ‘chinstrap’.”
chinstrap penguin 有黑色羽冠、白色臉部，以及一條從頭部一側延伸到另一側的黑色羽毛帶，這就是牠名字中的 “chinstrap”。
a particular species = the chinstrap penguin description = physical appearance所以答案是 A。

questions.prompt: “The IUCN showed little concern about the decline in chinstrap-penguin numbers.”
questions.translation: IUCN 對 chinstrap penguin 數量下降顯示出較低關注。

blocks.text: “Antarctic penguin colonies in some parts of Antarctica have declined during the past 50 years, mostly because of climate change, researchers say.”
研究人員表示，Antarctica 某些地區的 Antarctic penguin colonies 在過去 50 年下降，主要原因是氣候變化。
“It’s a little bit worrying as it means that something is shifting in the ecosystem and the fall in penguin numbers is reflecting that shift.”
這有點令人擔憂，因為它代表 ecosystem 正在改變，而企鵝數量下降正反映這種變化。
“IUCN” 是強定位詞，原文只在 B 段出現。
“The findings were surprising because, until now, the chinstraps have been deemed of ‘least concern’ by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).”
這些發現令人意外，因為直到現在，chinstrap penguins 一直被 International Union for Conservation of Nature 評為 “least concern”。
判斷：題目中的 “showed little concern” 對應原文的 “deemed of ‘least concern’”。這裡的 concern 是IUCN conservation status 的語言，不是單純情緒。原文表示：在這次巨大下降被發現之前，IUCN對 chinstrap penguin 的風險評級仍屬 least concern。題目方向和原文一致。
showed little concern= deemed of “least concern”所以答案是 TRUE。

questions.prompt: “Climate change is one reason for changes in the chinstrap penguin’s food chain.”
questions.translation: 氣候變化是 chinstrap penguin 食物鏈變化的原因之一。

blocks.text: “The reduced sea ice and warmer oceans caused by climate change have reduced the amount of krill…”
氣候變化造成海冰減少和海洋變暖，令 krill 數量下降。
“…all the evidence we have points to climate change as being responsible for the changes we are seeing.”
所有證據都指向 climate change，顯示它要為目前看到的變化負責。
“Climate change”、“food chain” 都在 E 段密集出現。題目中的 “one reason” 要留意，原文不需要說 climate change 是唯一因素，只要支援它是原因即可。
“Climate change is probably the underlying factor, and the effects are rippling through the food chain.”
氣候變化很可能是根本因素，而它的影響正在沿著食物鏈擴散。
“Penguins, seals, and whales all depend on krill, which depends on ice.”
企鵝、海豹和鯨魚都依賴 krill，而 krill 依賴 ice。
判斷：題目說 climate change 是食物鏈變化的 one reason。原文說它 probably 是 underlying factor，而且 effects rippling through the food chain。方向一致，答案是 TRUE。
one reason = probably the underlying factor changes in food chain = effects are rippling through the food chain所以答案是 TRUE。

questions.prompt: “Gentoo penguins are not affected by climate change.”
questions.translation: Gentoo penguins 不受氣候變化影響。

blocks.text: “However, there was also some good news, as the researchers reported an increase in gentoo-penguin populations in neighbouring colonies, beyond Elephant Island.”
然而，也有一些好消息：研究人員報告 Elephant Island 以外鄰近 colonies 的 gentoo penguin 數量增加。
“The gentoo is a species from further north and they appear to be colonising the area and are actually increasing in numbers.”
gentoo 是來自更北方的物種，牠們似乎正在 colonising 這個地區，而且數量確實正在增加。
“Gentoo penguins” 直接定位 F 段。題目中的 “not affected by climate change” 需要找unaffected / no effect / climate change has no impact 等意思。
原文只說：“the researchers reported an increase in gentoo-penguin populations…”
“they appear to be colonising the area and are actually increasing in numbers.”
研究人員報告 gentoo penguin 數量增加；牠們似乎正在殖民這一地區，而且數量確實正在上升。
判斷：原文有說 gentoo 數量增加，但沒有說牠們是否受 climate change 影響。數量增加不等於完全不受影響；文章也沒有明確說 climate change 對 gentoo 沒有 impact。題目加入了 “not affected by climate change” 這個額外命題，原文資料不足。

questions.prompt: “The ship has been used to record the 24 ______ to marine life around the world;”
questions.translation: 這艘船曾被用來記錄全球 marine life 面對的 ______。

blocks.text: “The Greenpeace Ship Esperanza” 直接定位 G 段。題目中的 “record” 對應原文 “documenting”
“The Greenpeace ship Esperanza has been documenting the threat to the oceans worldwide…”
Greenpeace ship Esperanza 一直記錄全球海洋面對的威脅。
record = documenting marine life around the world = oceans worldwide the ______ = the threat答案是 threat。

questions.translation: 運送 ______ 參與海外考察。

blocks.text: “The Greenpeace ship Esperanza has been documenting the threat to the oceans worldwide and transporting scientists on overseas expeditions.”
Greenpeace ship Esperanza 一直記錄全球海洋面對的威脅，並運送科學家參與海外考察。
文法檢查：空格在 “transport” 後面，需要名詞作受詞。原文是 “transporting scientists”，所以答案必須填scientists。

questions.prompt: “support the creation of 26 ______ to protect surveyed colonies.”
questions.translation: 支持建立 ______，以保護已調查的 colonies。

blocks.text: “protect surveyed colonies” 對應原文 “to protect many of the colonies surveyed”。
“Greenpeace has been campaigning for the establishment of three Antarctic sanctuaries to protect many of the colonies surveyed.”
Greenpeace 一直爭取建立三個 Antarctic sanctuaries，以保護許多已調查的 colonies。
support the creation of= campaigning for the establishment of surveyed colonies= colonies surveyed sanctuaries= sanctuaries答案是 sanctuaries。

paragraphOverview.title: 全文 Skim Roadmap：只看每段首尾句可見甚麼
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句先描述 chinstrap penguin 的外觀：黑色頭頂、白臉、像「下巴帶」一樣的黑色羽毛帶。最後一句轉到 habitat，列出 Antarctic Peninsula 北部、Antarctic / subantarctic islands，以及 Balleny Islands。只看首尾句，可以先判斷這段功能是「介紹物種身份 + 分布地點」。所以若題目問species description、physical features、where they live，很大機會回到 A 段。

首句直接說 Antarctic penguin colonies 在過去 50 年下降，主要原因是 climate change。最後一句引用 Noah Strycker，說 penguin numbers 的下降反映 ecosystem 正在 shifting。只看首尾句，可見這段功能是「引入整篇主題：過去 50 年 chinstrap penguin 數量急跌，以及這件事的生態意義」。IUCN、decline、climate change、ecosystem shift 都可能在這段定位。

首句指出 Elephant Island 每一個 colony 都 experienced a population decline。最後一句說不同colony 的下降幅度不同，其中 Chinstrap Camp 下降 77%。只看首尾句，這段明顯是「用數據證明下降」。中間很可能有 past survey 和 recent count 的比較，因此若題目問 current and past records、percentage decline、population comparison，C 段最值得掃描。

首句說 latest study 發表前不久，Antarctica 剛錄得 all-time high temperature 18.3°C。最後一句交代這個溫度由 Argentina’s Esperanza research station 記錄，來源是該國 meteorological agency。只看首尾句，這段功能很集中：提供 Antarctic temperature record 的背景資料。所以凡是highest temperature、recorded temperature、18.3°C、previous high，都應定位 D 段。

首句把 reduced sea ice、warmer oceans、climate change、reduced krill 連成因果鏈，並說 krill是 penguins’ diet 的 main component。最後一句由 Heather Lynch 補充，所有證據都指向climate change。只看首尾句，這段功能是「解釋食物鏈變化」。若題目問 food supply、krill、food chain、underlying factor、climate change effects，答案大多藏在 E 段。

首句用 however 帶出好消息：neighbouring colonies 的 gentoo-penguin populations 增加。最後一句說 gentoo 來自更北方，似乎正在 colonising the area，數量也正在 increasing。只看首尾句，可以判斷這段是對比段：chinstrap 下降，但 gentoo 增加。題目若問 gentoo penguins、comparison between penguin species、increase in neighbouring colonies，就應看 F 段。

首句介紹 Greenpeace ship Esperanza 的兩個用途：documenting the threat to the oceans worldwide，以及 transporting scientists on overseas expeditions。最後一句說 Greenpeace 爭取建立 Antarctic sanctuaries，這些地方 would be off-limits to humans。只看首尾句，這段同時處理research support、Low Island survey、proposed sanctuaries、human prohibition。Completion 題和 “off-limits” 題會集中在這裡。

首句引用 Louisa Casson，說 climate emergency 正在 decimating penguin numbers，並影響偏遠地區 wildlife。最後一句呼籲 governments 回應 science，在 United Nations 同意 strong Global Ocean Treaty，建立 ocean sanctuaries 以保護 marine life。只看首尾句，這段是 campaigning /policy appeal 段。若題目問 measures to protect marine species、Global Ocean Treaty、marine life protection，H 段最有價值。
